source_scope: Schuerr2005 revised transcription printed121–122/PDF27–28; source PDF, images and full transcription are not bundled.

method.font_decode: Exact-PDF font-specific mapping, visually checked against rendered transcription pages; custom m-tilde/e-tilde and chi glyphs decoded by named fonts only. Underdots retained from dedicated fonts, underlines from individual PDF drawing segments.
method.reference_offsets: Python Unicode code points, zero based, end exclusive; grapheme units keep complete original combining sequences and opaque entity markers. No stored reference normalization.
method.comparison_only: NFC per-unit comparison; source chi versus digital x is a declared transliteration convention. Neither is exact literal equality. Nasal-mark differences are not silently conflated.
method.algorithm: Minimum-cost whole-source-label alignment. Identical comparison keys0, letter substitution2, other substitution4, ordinary gap2, spacing gap1. All optimal-path partner ambiguity is flagged; deterministic traceback is only a candidate alignment.
method.meaning: Base/notation comparisons do not establish lexical meaning, physical signs, historical witness independence, accepted corrections or a definitive edition. All mismatch/qualification/ambiguity records remain unadjudicated.
method.public_replay: Public validation checks exact inputs, byte coverage and pinned alignment context; optional --pdf performs source-byte/glyph/algorithm replay with a lawfully held exact PDF.

rights.scope: Frozen eDiAna-derived literal units and original project comparison annotations. Source edition, PDF and images retain source rights; access is not bulk redistribution permission.
